idea-plugin.name: Alex McGuire Plugin
idea-plugin.description:
Personal actions.
  • Find Instance Creations - usages of the Scala class under the caret restricted to instance creation: constructor calls and companion apply calls, synthetic or hand-written. One variant searches the whole project, the other production only.
  • Window title - just the directory name that tells this project apart from the others open at the time, with no path and no file name.
  • Project tab order - the macOS project tabs are kept in a fixed order as projects open and close: non-topaz projects alphabetically, then topaz-main, the numbered development worktrees and the PR worktrees. Sort Project Tabs imposes it on demand.
  • Close Others and Pin - closes every open editor tab except the focused one, pinned tabs included and across all splits, then pins what is left.
